title: Stack Fingerprint
description: Output of the maintainer-detect-stack skill. Downstream skills (workflow-bootstrap, maintainer-fix, maintainer-commit-msg-why, maintainer-guardian, workflow-protect-branch) read this file to self-configure for the entrusted repo. Schema is intentionally permissive (no closed enums on extended fields) so new ecosystems can be added without breaking existing consumers.

primary_language.description: First match in the detection-matrix priority order.

package_manager.description: Sub-detected package manager. Per-language enum lives in detection-matrix.md §2. Allowed values include: uv, poetry, setuptools, pnpm, yarn, npm, cargo, gomod, bundler, composer, mix, pub, none.

tool_versions_manager.description: How (or whether) the repo pins language versions.

ci_files.description: List of CI workflow paths, populated only when ci_present is true.

dependabot_ecosystems.description: package-ecosystem values listed in dependabot.yml. Empty when dependabot_present is false.

branch_rules.description: active=ruleset enforced; absent=no ruleset; unknown=auth/admin missing or workflow-protect-branch SHOW chain failed.

hooks_present.description: Which git-hook artefacts are present. .git/hooks/<name> executable adds the bare name; .pre-commit-config.yaml adds pre-commit-fwk; package.json with husky adds husky.

test_framework.description: First match in detection-matrix.md §8. Allowed values include: pytest, jest, vitest, mocha, cargotest, gotest, rspec, none.

lint_setup.description: Every lint signal present. ruff, mypy, eslint, prettier, clippy, golangci-lint, rubocop, etc.

docs_present.description: Canonical-name docs that exist. README.md / CHANGELOG.md / CONTRIBUTING.md / SECURITY.md / CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md / LICENSE.

docs_missing.description: Canonical-name docs that do NOT exist. Same vocabulary as docs_present — the two arrays partition the canonical docs list.

skill.description: Downstream skill name (no .md extension, no skills/ prefix).

mode.description: Optional mode argument for the suggested skill (e.g. install, APPLY, SHOW).

reason.description: Human-readable one-liner explaining why this suggestion was generated.

file.description: Optional file path the suggestion targets (e.g. README.md for maintainer-generate-docs).

suggestions.description: Actionable next-step list, built per the suggestion-build rules in detection-matrix.md.

notes.description: Diagnostic notes from the detection pass — conflicts (e.g. both pyproject.toml and package.json), missing tools (e.g. jq), or skipped dimensions (e.g. branch_rules=unknown because gh unauth).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime + local TZ offset the fingerprint was generated. Compact form (no colons in the TZ offset) for filesystem-safe filenames downstream.

schema_version.description: Bumped only on breaking schema changes. Downstream consumers MUST tolerate missing optional fields but MUST refuse to consume a higher major version they were not built for.
